notes.title: The DESPA playtest is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]GLADIATORS, IT’S TIME![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544175/66f78f99cd730a3a953797be5a4863be032f7cf1.jpg[/img]
The arena is open, weapons are locked and loaded, and all that’s left is for you to step into the fight. There’s no room for the weak – either you win, or you get scrapped.
Are you in? Then prove you belong.
[b]When:[/b] [u]March 31, 2025 at 14.00 UTC | 16.00 CET[/u]
We need the truth! Don't forget to take [url=https://forms.gle/HfVPhWyuNpbfrj2V8]the poll[/url]. Have your say. Influence. Let's make the arena even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544175/33ae6f1c63f5de0a6277a0a866caf77e03e54df5.png[/img]
[b]BTW, LAST CHANCE TO WIN $25![/b]
Today is the final day of the giveaway! 5 winners will each receive a $25 Steam Gift Card.

You fought. You have left a mark in the arena of DESPA. Now it is your turn.

[b]How to participate?[/b]
[list]
[*] Add DESPA to your wishlist.
[*] Drop a screenshot in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mktSQ8tp3P]Discord[/url].
[/list]
Winners will be announced tomorrow – don’t miss out!
Join the test and enter the giveaway – today, the arena decides your fate!
